_comment: workspace-os guardrail rules for THIS repo. Copy to .claude/guardrails.json and edit. The engine reads only `bash` and `write`; `ip_class` and any `_`-prefixed key are informational. deny -> blocks the tool call; warn -> advisory message. Built-in warn-only defaults (secrets, force-push, rm -rf) always run regardless of this file. A rule may add a `predicate` (shell): it fires only when its regex matches AND the predicate exits 0, run in the call's cwd under a 5s timeout - so this file executes shell on matching tool calls and is part of the repo's trusted configuration, like repo-level hooks. `dispatch` rules gate subagent dispatches probe-first: the first matching dispatch per session per rule runs `probe` and is denied once with its output; the retry passes.

bash.name: tracking-audit-before-commit
bash.reason: tracking audit failed - run: python3 scripts/memory_graph.py --audit-tracking --tracking-root docs/project-tracking, fix, then retry.

bash.name: no-raw-duckdb
bash.reason: Use mcp__duckdb__query, not a raw DuckDB connection.

bash.name: no-writes-on-main
bash.reason: checkout is on main; switch to a feature branch first.

write.name: employer-tripwire
write.reason: clean-room repo: this write matches an employer tripwire string.

dispatch.name: pipeline-output-exists
dispatch.reason: the pipeline may already have written this; check before re-deriving.
